WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(1.0 * f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
count_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(fee_record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_ratio),
  SUM(p.fee_record_count),
  AVG(p.fee_record_count - c.avg_count)
FROM per_timespan AS p
CROSS JOIN count_average AS c
WHERE p.fee_record_count > c.avg_count;
